questionResults.question: Explain QuickSort partition logic and its average vs worst-case time complexity.
questionResults.answer: QuickSort chooses a pivot element and partitions the array such that all smaller elements go before the pivot and larger elements after. The average time complexity is O(n log n), while worst-case is O(n^2) if the pivot is the smallest or largest element each time.
